title: Snowknife multi-course repack manifest
description: Input to snowknife repack-many. Relative paths resolve from the manifest's directory.

TextureType2.description: Encode custom terrain and prop pages as retail-shaped 8-bit indexed type 2 instead of 32-bit type 5.

SoundRate.description: Encode every custom prop sound at this rate instead of the target bank's own. An override rather than a ceiling: clips are converted up as well as down. Omit it — the engine plays a slot at the bank's rate and ignores the sound's own tag, so the bank's rate is the only one that sounds right. Name a lower one only to buy bank bytes, accepting that the clips play sharp.
